query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN photo_url IS NOT NULL AND photo_url != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_photo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN photo_url IS NULL OR photo_url = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_photo
FROM keynote_speakers WHERE is_visible = 1;
